title: Dynamix Corp 8-K Filing — Termination of Business Combination Agreement
summary: Dynamix Corporation (SPAC, ticker ETHM) terminated its Business Combination Agreement with The Ether Reserve LLC on April 8, 2026, mutually releasing all parties from the July 2025 merger agreement. The Payor is required to pay Dynamix $50,000,000 within 15 days of the termination date.
key_points: Termination Agreement signed April 8, 2026 terminates Business Combination Agreement dated July 21, 2025 between Dynamix, Pubco, SPAC Merger Sub, The Ether Reserve LLC, and related parties
Payor must remit $50,000,000 to Dynamix within 15 days of April 8, 2026
ETHM Subscription Agreements and Contribution Agreement also terminated per their terms
Mutual releases executed between all parties for known and unknown claims
Dynamix has until November 22, 2026 to complete an initial business combination or must liquidate
Securities: Units (ETHMU), Class A shares (ETHM), Warrants (ETHMW) listed on Nasdaq
why_it_matters: This represents a SPAC deal failure with a negotiated termination fee. For equity investors in ETHM, the $50M payment provides partial recovery if the SPAC fails to find another target before its November 2026 deadline. The termination does not constitute a macro catalyst or affect broad market structure.
important_numbers: November 22, 2026 SPAC deadline to complete business combination
$100,000 interest reserve for liquidation trust account
